author_ground_truth_DEV_ONLY.note: Development-only field. Never expose to a system under test; never derivable from the shipped corpus. Preserved here so the corpus stays internally consistent if extended.
author_ground_truth_DEV_ONLY.true_cause: Valve V-3's actuator drifted open on its own due to documented vibration wear (see Day 12 inspection log and Day 88 replacement finding). No person touched the valve that night.
author_ground_truth_DEV_ONLY.why_never_fully_confirmable_in_corpus: The Day 88 actuator-wear finding narrows but does not prove the absence of human contact; Kenji's and Diego's logged proximity remain compatible with either explanation. No perturbation in this bundle resolves it — see Control F.

resolution_events.resolved_fact: Field Camp Delta relocated to the lee shelter on Day 59, returned to the main tent site on Day 63.

scope_dimensions.note: Most scope dimensions used by Experiments 03/04 (environment, platform, region, version, customer_tier, employment_class, release_channel, authority) are not narratively meaningful for a single physical station and are left null throughout this experiment's memory records, per the schema's null_scope note (null does not mean global).
